bugs_found: contract-validate silently accepts invalid contracts: validation errors call reporter.ok('schema OK') and iterate over an empty list, so schema violations never fail CI
review-gate does not enforce its documented 'latest round overall verdict=approve' condition; a later non-code-reviewer request-changes round can be ignored

review-gate dedupes findings using lexicographic filename order, not declared round_number ordering, so stale/resolved acks can overwrite newer unresolved findings, especially with round-10 vs round-2 style names
review-gate branch fallback uses the raw branch string as a path under .claude/reviews without sanitizing '..', allowing path traversal outside the intended review directory
review-validate and review-gate load schema/JSON files without handling FileNotFoundError or JSONDecodeError for schemas, causing crashes instead of configuration-error exit code 2
load_yaml_file can return None/non-dict for an empty or scalar profile; downstream .get calls can crash instead of reporting malformed profile consistently
